text:
priya s: starting a controlled rollout for ff `compact-llm-router`. plan: 0% -> 1% -> 5% -> 20% over 45m. runbook: https://confluence.redwood/KB/compact-llm-router
dan k: ack. window 01:30-03:00 UTC. main gates: p95 latency, error-rate, and model-quality quick-check. rollback thresholds: p95 +20% for 5m or errors >1.4x baseline.
deploy-bot: deploy job 6110 queued by priya s. image rwd/compact-route:v20260325. dry-run passed.
priya s: pin fallback so we can revert fast: `rwdctl config set routing.fallback v1 --pin`
release-bot: release note stub created; will add rollback snippet.
deploy-bot: feature flag compact-llm-router -> 1% applied. cohorts live.
dan k: initial telemetry looks fine. holding 10m then to 5% if green.
sre-oncall: standing by. set autopause: p95 delta 25% for 3m.
deploy-bot: feature flag -> 5% applied after hold.
alexa m: running quick eval sweep on sample prompts. quality neutral so far.
dan k: seeing small KV cache churn increase on one router pod, but autoscaler handled it, no errors.
priya s: ok proceed to 20% but attach canary image for suspected cache tweak: image rwd/compact-route:v20260325b available if needed.
deploy-bot: ramping to 20% now. cohorts updated.
alan (log): autopause triggered: p95 delta exceeded for long-context flows at 14:21 UTC. rollout paused at 20%.
priya s: do not immediate rollback. set targeted cohort tweak to reduce long-context routing weight for cohorts >10%: `rwdctl ff tweak compact-llm-router --cohort-threshold 10 --long-context-weight 0.5`
deploy-bot: cohort tweak applied. long-context traffic reduced for affected cohorts.
alexa m: re-running evals on adjusted traffic; quality improving but 0.5% regression remains on one slice.
dan k: recommend hold and investigate overnight. prepare rollback snippet in runbook: `rwdctl ff set compact-llm-router 0 --reason "auto-pause" && rwdctl config unpin routing.fallback`
release-bot: rollout status updated: PAUSED @20% due to perf/quality. link: https://release.redwood/status/6110
sre-oncall: acknowledged. will alert if autopause re-triggers.
priya s: thanks team. will follow up with a short investigation note in the AM and decide between targeted fixes vs full rollback. :eyes:
